remarks: This stunning custom-built home, completed in 2005, showcases exceptional craftsmanship and timeless design throughout. Rich millwork, refined architectural details, and high-end finishes create an elegant yet inviting atmosphere across every level.  Ideally situated in a quiet, sought-after location, the home offers the perfect balance of privacy and convenience, just moments from town, restaurants, and local shops.  The second floor features five spacious en-suite bedrooms, offering both comfort and privacy for family and guests alike. A versatile third-level bonus space provides endless possibilities-ideal for a media room, additional lounge, or creative retreat-alongside a dedicated home office and private gym to suit today's lifestyle needs.  The fully finished walk-out lower level is designed for both relaxation and recreation, featuring a generous playroom that seamlessly connects to the backyard. This level is complete with a full bath and a thoughtfully designed craft room, perfect for hobbies or additional flexible use.  A rare opportunity to own a beautifully appointed home with exceptional space, functionality, and an unbeatable location.
